about: Confirmed app wallets for Elysium Terminal. A burn on Elysium, or KNTQ reaching Hyperliquid's Assistance Fund, is credited to 'the sequencer or apps' when it comes from one of these, or when every inflow of the wallet that sent it traces back to one within 3 hops. The sequencer fee account and Ascend's burn treasury are read from the chain on every refresh and are not listed here.
howToAdd: Add an object to apps: address (0x...), chain (elysium, hypercore or hyperevm), app (its name), label (what the wallet is), evidence (a link where the app itself states this address), added (YYYY-MM-DD). Only add an address the app has published or confirmed. Add counted: false for a project wallet that is shown in the projects table but never credited as the sequencer or apps (its burns stay out of queued and burned on Elysium).
howToAddProject: Add an object to projects: name, commitment (short, e.g. "40% of net trading revenue"), kinetiq (its slug in Kinetiq's projects-buying-KNTQ data, or null), and optionally note. A project is verified on chain once at least one of its wallets is listed under apps with app equal to its name; the next refresh then reads that wallet's whole history, not only what comes after. The Elysium sequencer and Ascend are read from the chain and need no wallet here. Set kind to "buy" for a project that buys KNTQ but does not burn it.

projects.name: Elysium sequencer
projects.commitment: 42.5% of sequencer fees (50% of the 85% Elysium keeps)

projects.name: Ascend
projects.commitment: 28.8% of its protocol share, to a burn treasury

projects.commitment: 43.2% of its protocol share, to a strategic treasury

projects.name: Markets.xyz
projects.note: Kinetiq credits Markets.xyz with a share of Assistance Fund deposits. Already counted in total burned. Runs on Hyperliquid, not Elysium.

projects.name: Nest
projects.note: Goes to NEST lockers, not burned.

projects.name: Montra
projects.commitment: Its pools' KNTQ fees go to MONTRA buybacks
